segments.text:
V. 2.
At the riſing of the ſun—They ſet out while it was yet dark, and came within Sight of the Sepulchre, for the firſt Time, juſt as it grew light enough to diſcern that the Stone was rolled away. (Mat. xxviii. 1. Luke xxiv. 1. John xx. 1.) But by the Time
Mary had called Peter and John, and they had viewed the Sepulchre, the Sun was riſing.
